The old scalar K23 objectives4 and12 are different problems. This run constructs five-vertex/six-edge diagonal matrix defects: a0->bk has Dk=3Ekk-I, a1->bk has0. Zero trace-zero repair has objective6. Duals ±Dk/3 have spread1 and zero divergence. All-Hermitian repair uses potential I at a0, with residuals3Ekk, cost9/2; duals ±Dk/4 have operator norm≤1/2 and zero divergence. That identity potential is not trace-zero. Source publications remain unchanged and no erratum is claimed filed.
